boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified campus and nearby activities with free admission or no additional charge for fee-paying UH Mānoa students.

cards.entity_name: University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa Campus Arboretum
cards.title: Take a tree walk through the Campus Arboretum
cards.subtitle: University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa campus
cards.notes: Meet under a landmark tree, then take a slow loop through campus and compare plants from Hawaiʻi, the Pacific, and the tropics.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided outdoor plant walk across the accredited campus arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: The UH Mānoa Campus Arboretum is open to the public and admission is free; donations are optional.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; admission is free. Donations are appreciated.

cards.title: Walk the trails at Lyon Arboretum
cards.subtitle: 3860 Manoa Road, Honolulu
cards.notes: Sign in at the Visitors Center, choose a trail that fits your group’s pace, and check the closure notices before heading up the valley.
cards.short_summary: A public botanical-garden outing in Mānoa Valley.
cards.evidence_claim: Lyon Arboretum states that general-public admission is free, with a suggested donation.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; sign in at the Visitors Center and check for intermittent construction closures.

cards.title: See an exhibition at the UH Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Art Building, 2535 McCarthy Mall
cards.notes: Pick an exhibition day, meet in the Art Building’s bamboo court, and give yourselves time to look before discussing one work each.
cards.short_summary: A free campus-gallery visit centered on rotating visual-art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Department of Art and Art History lists free admission for the Art Gallery at UH Mānoa.
cards.access_notes: The cited gallery page lists free admission; check the department’s current exhibition information before going.

cards.title: Browse the Commons Gallery together
cards.subtitle: Art Building, 2535 McCarthy Mall
cards.notes: Start at the ground-floor gallery, view the work at your own pace, and use the gallery windows if staffed hours are limited.
cards.short_summary: A free contemporary-art stop in the Art Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Commons Gallery’s official exhibition page lists free admission and identifies it in the Art Building’s ground floor.
cards.access_notes: The official page says the gallery is viewable through its windows 24/7; staffed hours vary, so confirm current exhibition details.

cards.title: Explore the John Young Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Krauss Hall, 2500 Dole Street
cards.notes: Visit the galleries and courtyard in Krauss Hall, then trade observations about the museum’s Asia-Pacific-focused collection and current programs.
cards.short_summary: A free museum visit with exhibitions and an outdoor courtyard.
cards.evidence_claim: The John Young Museum of Art’s official site states that admission is free and notes its Krauss Hall location.
cards.access_notes: Free admission; donations are appreciated. Parking fees may apply on campus.

cards.title: Join basketball open play at the WRC
cards.subtitle: Warrior Recreation Center, lower campus
cards.notes: Bring athletic clothes and a validated UH Mānoa ID, then join the posted basketball open-play session with classmates or a pickup group.
cards.short_summary: Student open basketball at the campus recreation center.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa Recreation lists basketball open play at the Warrior Recreation Center, and fee-paying students receive facility access without additional cost.
cards.access_notes: For current fall/spring mandatory fee-paying UH Mānoa students, access is provided without additional cost; bring a validated ID and check the facilities schedule.

cards.title: Drop into volleyball open play
cards.subtitle: Warrior Recreation Center, lower campus
cards.notes: Check the recreation schedule, arrive with appropriate athletic attire, and use volleyball open play for an easy group activity between classes.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled student open-play volleyball session at the WRC.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa Recreation lists volleyball open play at the Warrior Recreation Center, while eligible fee-paying students have access without additional cost.
cards.access_notes: No additional charge for current fall/spring mandatory fee-paying UH Mānoa students; posted sessions and facility availability can change.

cards.title: Meet for open swim at Duke Kahanamoku
cards.subtitle: Duke Kahanamoku Aquatic Complex, lower campus
cards.notes: Bring swim gear and your validated UH Mānoa ID, then plan around the posted open-swim block instead of assuming the pool is available.
cards.short_summary: Student open swimming in the campus aquatic complex.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa Recreation lists open swim at Duke Kahanamoku Aquatic Complex and includes aquatic-complex access for eligible students without additional cost.
cards.access_notes: Current fall/spring mandatory fee-paying UH Mānoa students have access without additional cost; confirm the current open-swim schedule.

cards.title: Play badminton at Klum Gym
cards.subtitle: Klum Gym, lower campus
cards.notes: Bring a validated UH Mānoa ID and confirm the schedule first; badminton is offered in specific recreation blocks rather than all day.
cards.short_summary: A student badminton session in the lower-campus gym.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa Recreation lists badminton at Klum Gym, and current fall/spring mandatory fee-paying students receive recreation access without additional cost.
cards.access_notes: No additional charge for current fall/spring mandatory fee-paying UH Mānoa students; the official schedule shows badminton may be closed during some terms.

cards.title: Rally during tennis open play
cards.subtitle: UH Tennis Complex, lower campus
cards.notes: Coordinate a partner, bring your own racquet and balls, and check the term schedule before walking over to the courts for open play.
cards.short_summary: Student tennis open play at the campus tennis complex.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa Recreation lists tennis open play at the UH Tennis Complex and includes tennis among open-recreation access for eligible students without additional cost.
cards.access_notes: Current fall/spring mandatory fee-paying UH Mānoa students have recreation access without additional cost; equipment is not stated as provided, and seasonal court hours vary.
